name: jira-confluence-quicktext
description: Quinta Jira + Confluence tools for self-hosted Data Center — 69 tools (53 Jira + 16 Confluence). Each user connects with their own Personal Access Token.

jira_base_url.title: Jira Base URL
jira_base_url.description: Your self-hosted Jira Data Center URL (no trailing slash).

jira_api_token.title: Jira Personal Access Token
jira_api_token.description: Your OWN Jira PAT (Profile → Personal Access Tokens). Stored locally in your OS keychain — never shared.

jira_auth_type.title: Jira Auth Type
jira_auth_type.description: "bearer" for a Personal Access Token (default), or "basic" for username+token.

jira_user_email.title: Jira Username/Email (basic auth only)
jira_user_email.description: Only needed if Jira Auth Type is "basic". Leave blank for bearer/PAT.

confluence_base_url.title: Confluence Base URL
confluence_base_url.description: Your self-hosted Confluence URL. Leave the token blank below to disable Confluence tools.

confluence_api_token.title: Confluence Personal Access Token
confluence_api_token.description: Your OWN Confluence PAT. Leave blank to disable Confluence tools. Stored locally in your OS keychain.
